One projection fix (cos-roll foreshortening + deck as translucent layer-zero like the floor sheet's subfloor convention) plus flag-not-label honesty closes the round; the roof-sheet legend rows for the three new classes belong to the plan-set owner (sibling file) and are scored as a follow-up FLAG.

The takeoff (which correctly books what renders, S4) therefore under-buys roof sheathing AND underlayment (the +10% lap factor rides the under-tiled area) on every hip — the dangerous direction for a purchase list. The only disclosure anywhere is the member-label suffix '— tapered plane strip-tiled; trimmed at hips (slight under-tile)': 'slight' is quantitatively false at 15.6%, the code comment's own '~8%' bound doesn't hold off the default geometry, and the demanded '~92%' statement exists NOWHERE — not on the labels, not in the takeoff row detail, not as a flag. Labels do not print on sheets, so a plans/estimate reader has NO signal at all.
